doc.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Opening and introductions in Clearwater Beach
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the session and John Lamb, noting he was born in Florida.

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Clearwater Beach and I’m very pleased to have bassist John Lamb with me here today.
And I’ve been looking forward to talking to you for a couple of weeks now. You’ve kind of come full circle. You were born down here, weren’t you?
